candidate_evidence.quote: Patients were enrolled and given bevacizumab on days 1 and 15, administered by intravenous infusion at 5 mg/kg.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab Neoadjuvant Therapy for New High-grade Gliomas in the Brain

role_evidence.quote: The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of bevacizumab in the preoperative adjuvant treatment of patients with new-onset high-grade gliomas.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: binds VEGF-A, blocking VEGFR-mediated signalling and inhibiting tumour angiogenesis and growth

coder_notes: Population is 'high-grade glioma' by imaging diagnosis; glioblastoma appears only in the summary and description, not in conditions, title, eligibility or an arm label. Bevacizumab (established GBM therapy, D6) is tested in a new preoperative setting, hence established_therapy_experiment. Registered phase is NA.
